note: Route catalogue for the intake smoke corpus. Every case is judged against all routes; per-case eligibility is a deterministic gate.

routes.description: Change source code in the repository: add or fix a function, flag, parser, test, bug or command.
Edit documentation only: README, design notes, docstrings, wording, typos or prose examples. No code changes.
Review an existing translation between Chinese, Japanese and English for omissions, meaning changes or terminology errors.
Answer a question from benchmark results data: compute a statistic, filter trials, compare runs or arms.
The request concerns this project but is too vague to act on; ask the requester for the missing details.
